text: In August of 2025 we returned, as the record shows, to one phrase above all. Nine of us said "big beautiful bill" on 2025-08-13; eight of us said "the one big beautiful bill" the same day. Kevin Hern reached it first, on 2025-01-08; the longer form traces to Lloyd Smucker on 2025-03-04. Five of us said "the one big beautiful bill act," first spoken by Jodey C. Arrington on 2025-05-16. Around this we arranged the machinery of the calendar: six of us said "the fiscal year," six said "this bipartisan legislation," five said "the senate appropriations committee," five said "military construction veterans affairs," five said "food and drug administration." We named the bill more ways than we named anything else. That is what our record from this era holds.
